chunks: And among them is Abdul Aziz bin Al-Muhtadi Al-Qummi Al-Ashari:
ai.seo_question: Who is Abdul Aziz bin Al-Muhtadi Al-Qummi Al-Ashari in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Abdul Aziz bin Al-Muhtadi Al-Qummi Al-Ashari is presented as a key figure among the four prominent emissaries (al-wukala al-arba'a) who bridged the gap between the Twelfth Imam and the general Shia community during the Major Occation. His inclusion in Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* underscores the institutionalized structure of religious authority and guidance that maintained communal cohesion and jurisprudential continuity in the absence of the Imam.
